question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Final verification - bowler with lowest bowling average
WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler,
           COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as runs_off_bat,
           CASE WHEN er.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) ELSE 0 END as bowler_extras
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT bowler, 
           SUM(runs_off_bat) as total_runs_off_bat,
           SUM(bowler_extras) as total_bowler_extras
    FROM ball_data
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT br.bowler, p.player_name, br.total_runs_off_bat + br.total_bowler_extras as total_runs_conceded, bw.wickets,
       (br.total_runs_off_bat + br.total_bowler_extras) * 1.0 / bw.wickets as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1
